name: orca-crew
description: The orchestrator/worker session model over Orca orchestration: roles by alias, the twelve-step run, brief templates, one review per PR.

interface.longDescription: Orca Crew states who does what when one orchestrator session drives GLM worker sessions through Orca orchestration: which alias fills each role, what a brief must carry, where the orchestrator stops and dispatches instead, one code review per PR with findings returned through worker_done, GitHub threads worked to zero, and a merge only on the operator's explicit word. It defers every Orca command to the Orca binary's own version-matched guide.
defaultPrompt: Start an orchestrator run for this objective.
Spawn a claude-glm worker for this task.
Review PR 123 in a flash session.
